sources.selection: Rigid motion branch, excluding skinned vertex history

adaptations: Selected standalone float32 functions; retained upstream copyright and permission notices.
Expanded float32 math helper macros and material constants.
Removed Slang default arguments; GLSL callers pass k explicitly.
Extracted the two NEECacheUtils triangle sampling helpers as standalone GLSL functions, without the NEE cache.
The solid-angle PDF helper accepts selection probability / triangle area, and guards zero-distance and non-finite connections.

Extracted the rigid motion branch of surfaceInteractionCreate into calculateRigidMotion; expanded interpolation and replaced Slang mul with GLSL multiplication. Previous transforms and current hits use their respective camera origins for Minecraft world-border precision; no skinned-vertex history is assumed.

Frame-history invalidation follows rtx_context.cpp / NRDContext: view discontinuities reset globally; ordinary scene, light and entity updates use per-pixel rejection. The temporal and a-trous filter remains this module’s implementation, not NRD.
The module uses its own global area/power-weighted alias table and balance MIS against its diffuse/GGX mixture; the final surface has no competing BSDF sample.
Minecraft scene layout, BVH traversal, integration, temporal filtering and Vulkan host code are implemented in this module.
This is a port of the listed shading functions, not the complete Remix renderer, RTXDI, NRC or DLSS.
